summary.general: Caution: this record jumps when its input data changed, so its trend is not a climate signal.
summary.expert: Caution: this trend contains step changes and should not be read as a climate signal.

gldas_tair.details: GLDAS-2.1 air temperature comes from the NOAA GDAS operational analysis used to force the model. Against MERRA-2 over the same land cells, its global land mean shifts by about +0.4 K in May 2011, +0.6 K in July 2017 and −0.6 K in June 2019, the months of GDAS/GFS upgrades in the NCEP change log. At Taichung it also steps by 1 K or more against the station record.

summary.general: Caution: this record has a jump that a second, independent product does not show.
summary.expert: Caution: this series contains a step that an independent product does not show.

gldas_evap.reason: the series contains a step that an independent product does not show.
gldas_evap.details: From July 2024 to May 2025 the GLDAS-2.1 downward shortwave forcing runs 15–32 W m⁻² above that of FLDAS (same Noah model family, MERRA-2 forcing) over the same land cells, and GLDAS global land evapotranspiration runs about 0.1–0.2 mm/day (1–2 × 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻² s⁻¹) above FLDAS; both differences are gone by July 2025. The GLDAS-2 README records that the cloud analysis behind its radiation input was decommissioned in summer 2024 and that radiation switched to GALWEM on 9 June 2025. Over 2001–2026 the GLDAS global land trend is +0.058 mm/day per decade against +0.012 for FLDAS.

summary.general: Caution: two model products disagree on whether this goes up or down.
summary.expert: Caution: two model products disagree on the sign of this trend.

gldas_soilmoist.reason: two model products disagree on its sign.
gldas_soilmoist.details: Over the same land cells and months (January 2001 to July 2026), the global land trend of 0–10 cm soil moisture is −0.43 kg m⁻² per decade in GLDAS-2.1 and +0.16 in FLDAS (same Noah model family, MERRA-2 and CHIRPS forcing), and the two global land series correlate at only 0.08. FLDAS is also a model simulation and the only product compared, so this check cannot tell which of the two is closer to the truth. No clear step was found at the GDAS/GFS upgrade months (May 2011, July 2017, June 2019).
